Usage:   linear       
Version: 3.0.0-alpha.1

Description:

  Handy linear commands from the command line.                                
                                                                              
  Environment Variables:                                                      
    LINEAR_DEBUG=1              Show full error details including stack traces
    LINEAR_IGNORE_ENV_FILE=1    Skip loading .env files                       

Options:

  -h, --help             - Show this help.                            
  -V, --version          - Show the version number for this program.  
  --workspace    <slug>  - Target workspace (uses credentials)        

Commands:

  auth                                      - Manage Linear authentication                                               
  issue, i                                  - Manage Linear issues                                                       
  team, t                                   - Manage Linear teams                                                        
  user, u                                   - Manage Linear users                                                        
  project, p                                - Manage Linear projects                                                     
  project-update, pu                        - Manage project status updates                                              
  cycle, cy                                 - Manage Linear team cycles                                                  
  milestone, m                              - Manage Linear project milestones                                           
  initiative, init                          - Manage Linear initiatives                                                  
  initiative-update, iu                     - Manage initiative status updates (timeline posts)                          
  label, l                                  - Manage Linear issue labels                                                 
  template                                  - Browse Linear issue, project, and document templates. Apply one with `issue
                                              create --template` or `project create --template`.                         
  document, docs, doc                       - Manage Linear documents                                                    
  completions                               - Generate shell completions.                                                
  config, configure                         - Interactively generate .linear.toml configuration                          
  schema                                    - Print the GraphQL schema to stdout                                         
  api                    [graphqlDocument]  - Make a raw GraphQL API request                                             
  markdown                                  - Linear-flavored Markdown: mentions and collapsible sections
